---
title: "Session 15 · Bootstrap, permutation, and resampling design"
---

## From simulation to resampling

Session 14 specifies a population and generates new trials. Session 15 starts
with one dataset and uses bootstrap samples for estimation uncertainty and
allowed label permutations for a null comparison. Cross-validation remains
with regression models in Session 16.

The lecture retains the melanoma and promotion-study examples and uses SBP
reduction for its worked trial. The lab reuses the weight-loss dataset from
Session 14, with a guided function review and one-resample examples before loops.

## Lab route

1. Review the functions.
2. Choose a resampling plan.
3. Inspect the fixed dataset and observed estimate.
4. Try one within-arm bootstrap.
5. Repeat the bootstrap and estimate uncertainty.
6. Try one allowed permutation.
7. Repeat permutations and calculate the p-value.
8. Explain the two kinds of uncertainty and report.

Paired and clustered-data coding and advanced interval details are optional.
